tricks.trick: PURE = Particles Uniform, Really Equal — सब particles chemically same type के।
MIX = More than one Independent Xubstance (substance) — दो या ज़्यादा pure substances.
HOMO = Homely One look (एक जैसा); HETERO = Have Extra Two looks (अलग-अलग दिखते हिस्से).
SOLUTE is the 'little' one that dissolves; SOLVENT is the 'big' one that dissolves it — SOlute SOlves Into solvent.
SAT = Stop Adding — संतृप्त पर और विलेय Stop; UNSAT = still Under capacity.
SUSPEND = See Under Settling Particles Eventually — दिखते हैं, बैठते हैं।
C-T-S: Colloid shows Tyndall, Stays stable — CTS याद रखो।
P for Physical = Properties look change, Particle recipe same; C for Chemical = Composition Changes, Create new substance.
MALT-C: Metals are Attractive (lustre), Lead electricity, Thin wires (ductile), Can hammer (malleable) + Clang (sonorous).
